review_type: Independent content review of two original model-authored HTML artifacts
rubric: Every category starts at full points. Each Warning defect deducts one quarter of its category maximum; sum within category first and round to nearest 0.5, exact midpoint upward. Critical category score is zero. Verdict is worst of score/Critical/Warning bands (PASS: >=85, zero Critical, <=3 Warnings).
browser_method: Installed Playwright Node API with headless Chromium; user-directed actual browser review instead of an MCP-unavailable exemption. Offline context, exact in-memory URL allowlist, sandbox allow-scripts and CSP sandbox, blocked network connections/WebSockets/workers, no permissions or downloads; original artwork bytes and pinned local runtime served unchanged. No local web server or API calls.
scope_note: Approval covers these original artwork hashes, not production wrapper/catalog deployment or any broader site change.

findings.problem: The interaction hint and live status use 14.08px text; the description uses 15.2px and footer/model name uses 12px. These informative strings are below the review rubric’s 14pt (18.67px) target. They remain readable with browser enlargement and have strong contrast.
findings.action: On an authorized model-authored revision, raise informative text and controls to at least 19px while retaining the current responsive reflow.

artifacts.review_scope: Exact original artwork in a temporary sandbox allow-scripts iframe; unpublished production wrappers excluded.

browser_summary.720_width_note: Reflow proxy for a 1440px desktop at 200% browser zoom; not an assertion of an OS accessibility audit.

source_omissions.source_section: Single offline HTML, phone/desktop and accessibility consideration
source_omissions.evidence: Embedded CSS/JS, no external requests, responsive layout, keyboard buttons/live status, reduced-motion handler. Size warning remains.

findings.problem: SVG drawing labels are 10 SVG units and render at 5.6167 CSS pixels on the 375px phone viewport (337px-wide SVG / 600-unit viewBox). Essential disclosures, control instructions and source notes elsewhere also use 11–12px text. Tiny drawing labels make dimensions and conceptual notes hard to read without magnification.
findings.action: On an authorized model-authored revision, use responsive drawing label sizing or a keyboard/touch-accessible drawing zoom; make informative surrounding text at least 19px and diagram labels at least 12px at the displayed scale.

findings.problem: The common SVG label color #66817b on #f8faf7 has 4.009:1 contrast, below 4.5:1 for small normal text. The unselected stage number color #79918a on #f8faf8 is 3.214:1; muted #647478 on paper #f4f2eb is 4.348:1.
findings.action: On an authorized model-authored revision, darken these informative text colors to reach at least 4.5:1 against their actual backgrounds.
